categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in wind power equipment manufacturing, focusing on onshore wind turbine towers (steel and concrete hybrid towers) and offshore wind and marine engineering equipment, including offshore towers, jackets, piles, and substations. It also engages in zero-carbon business through wind farm development and operation, and innovation activities including high-end intelligent manufacturing and commercial aerospace components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for large-scale steel and concrete wind turbine towers, including high-strength steel welding, fatigue performance evaluation, and corrosion-resistant coatings. It has developed proprietary manufacturing processes such as high-efficiency deep penetration welding and floating foundation construction for offshore wind turbines. The company holds over 300 patents covering design, manufacturing, quality inspection, and tooling innovations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global wind turbine manufacturers such as Vestas and Goldwind, as well as other domestic and international wind power developers. The company serves the wind power industry, supplying critical structural components for onshore and offshore wind farms, and expanding into overseas markets across Asia, Europe, Africa, Australia, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates multiple production bases across China in regions including East China, North China, Northwest China, Northeast China, and South China, with strategic overseas presence in Canada and Germany. Its sales and projects cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets in Europe, Asia, Australia, Africa, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the wind power supply chain, manufacturing key structural components such as wind turbine towers and marine engineering equipment. It also extends downstream into wind farm development and operation through its zero-carbon business segment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding manufacturing capacity, especially for hybrid concrete towers and offshore wind equipment, enhancing technological innovation in large-scale and floating offshore wind foundations, and developing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company invests in R&D collaborations with universities and focuses on patent development, standard-setting participation, and commercial aerospace technology expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of wind power equipment products, including steel and concrete towers and offshore marine structures. The company also earns income from wind farm electricity generation and related zero-carbon projects, as well as from innovation and other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the wind turbine tower and marine engineering equipment sector, recognized for high product quality and technological leadership. It holds a strong market position with significant scale and certifications, competing with other major wind equipment suppliers domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.84 billion, a slight increase of 0.52% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 182 million, a decrease of 37.77%. The company has a total asset base exceeding RMB 9.4 billion and continues to expand production capacity and overseas market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, diversified product offerings including large-capacity steel and hybrid concrete towers, advanced offshore wind structures, and innovative floating foundations. It leverages strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive certifications to deliver reliable, customized solutions that meet stringent international standards and customer requirements, supporting clients' green energy transition goals.
